work_item: Exact world scope and polarity through Core relation proof and correction
producer_consumer: A direct typed Engine rule request with different premise/conclusion scopes reaches the Core rule consumer, which suspends with SCOPE_MISMATCH before content adoption or render.
Same-scope positive Fact and Rule are consumed by exact relation query and proof derivation; Fact/Rule IDs flow into the adopted ContentPlan and rendered result.
A negative direct Fact cannot satisfy the positive Rule premise. A positive question contradicted by the negative Fact retains that negative Fact ID in its explanation plan and rendered bytes.

Core correct_atomic_relation moves one exact positive Fact from lab scope to archive scope; the previous fact and its dependent result stop, the replacement Fact is available only in archive, and unrelated negative Fact plus lab Rule remain valid.
